page_title: Orbi — Lights-out software factory, open source (AGPL-3.0): File an Issue. Get a release.

sources.entry: Orbi - Open-source agent that takes a labeled GitHub issue to a reviewed, merged pull request and a tagged release; also runs ops tickets. #freemium #opensource

summary.name: Orbi
summary.one_liner: Orbi is a self-hosted, open source (AGPL-3.0) "lights-out" software factory that turns labeled GitHub Issues into reviewed, merged pull requests and tagged releases using AI coding agents.
keywords: write code from issues with ai
use_cases: Turn labeled GitHub Issues into merged pull requests without supervising each step
Have an independent AI session review and repair agent-written code before merge
Automatically tag releases once reviewed changes merge
Run an AI coding agent on your own repository and keys
Handle ops tickets with an AI agent
summary.what_it_does: Orbi picks up GitHub Issues labeled ai-ready, writes the code in an isolated git worktree, and opens a normal GitHub pull request. A second, independent agent session reviews the exact diff against the Issue's acceptance criteria, can change the branch to fix failures, reruns the test suite, and judges the repaired head. Only the reviewed commit is allowed to merge, after which Orbi tags the release. Orbi keeps its state in GitHub (Issues, PRs, labels, run ID), so restarts reconstruct the same run, branch, worktree and PR. Self-hosted installs use any OpenAI-compatible API or a local model; Managed Cloud is also offered.
notable: Independent second-session AI review that can change code and rerun tests, not just comment
Merges only the exact reviewed commit (SHA), with normal branch protection and human approvals still applying
Recovery after crashes is reconstructed from GitHub Issue, PR, labels and run ID
Self-hosted core is free; you pay your model provider directly
caveats: Self-hosted setup requires Python 3.14, git, gh, systemd and a model endpoint; the page lists Linux and macOS support
Managed Cloud is paid after 3 free merged deliveries: Solo US$29/month and Pro US$79/month monthly (annual options listed), plus a founding-partner offer with limited places
Managed Cloud runner clones the authorized repository onto machines Orbi operates during a delivery
